title: Assemble and prove the canonical foundation release
objective: Assemble the four approved foundation packages into one self-contained, versioned, deterministic release with ordering guidance, accessibility validation, migration notes, and isolated consumer proof.

included: package typography, colour, space-layout, and geometry-controls without changing their canonical values
define dependency and CSS loading order
generate a unified manifest, version metadata, integrity hashes, licences, guidance, and migration notes
validate accessibility, contrast, responsive, forced-colour, reduced-motion, clean-copy, and isolated consumer usage
build a bounded foundation-release proof and promotion gate

acceptance: one deterministic release contains all declared foundation entrypoints and licences
source package hashes and decision IDs are preserved
release status and production authority are explicit
isolated fixtures prove loading order, typography, modes, responsive profiles, controls and accessibility
human release verdict can be recorded without changing source foundations

verification.passCondition: source package hashes, manifests, approval records and unified release agree after deterministic rebuild
release builds and serves from an isolated directory with no canonical-checkout dependency
responsive, contrast, keyboard, focus, forced-colour and reduced-motion fixtures pass from 320px through wide desktop
Olli approves the complete foundation release for promotion

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Does this release faithfully package the four approved foundations as one portable, coherent, production-useful system without introducing new design decisions?

stopConditions: a release build changes any canonical source package or approval record
an entrypoint, font, licence, manifest, accessibility fixture or migration note is missing
isolated consumer proof depends on the canonical checkout
the task introduces product-expression, homepage, Figma, or consumer-specific design work
notes: Begin with a read-only inventory of all four canonical package manifests and overlapping entrypoints.
This is integration and release engineering, not a new taste gate for already approved values.
The migration identity release 0.1.0-alpha.1 remains immutable and distinct.
